items.title: RDML Burns joins DAIVIN! as Senior Advisor!
items.summary: We’re pleased to welcome Rear Admiral Matthew Burns , U.S. Navy (Ret.) as Senior Advisor to DAIVIN! (YC W26) Rear Admiral Burns served more than three decades in Naval Special Warfare and Joint Special Operations, rising from an enlisted Navy SEAL to Rear Admiral through the Navy’s Seaman-to-Admiral program - a rare path in the U.S. military.His career includes leadership roles as Commander of Naval Special Warfare Development Group (DEVGRU), Assistant Commander & Director of Operations at Joint

items.title: DAIVIN! Tests tankless dive technology successfully!
items.summary: DAIVIN! has successfully tested world first tankless dive technology. Powered by electrolysis this step opens up a big future potential for breathing technologies in the market. We are on a mission to make oxygen evermore accessible to people in a more safer and reliable way!See the video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r5HfL8Bw0dw

items.title: DAIVIN! is part of Y-Combinator
items.summary: DAIVIN! is pleased to announce its participation in Y-Combinator W26 batch! Read more here: https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/PE1-daivin-we-let-humans-breathe-underwater-without-oxygen-tanks
